definitions.explanation: Something that has just come into being or is being done for the first time.
Starting again with a fresh perspective or approach.

examples.japanese: {新|あら}たな⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
{新|あら}たな⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てた→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
{新|あら}たな⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}みたい→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
examples.english: I want to approach work with a fresh mindset.

examples.japanese: {新|あら}た⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{始|はじ}めましょう→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{新|あら}た⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{新年|しんねん}→新年：09787_shinnen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}え→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧、⟦{決意|けつい}→決意：07167_ketsui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{新|あら}た⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: As the new year began, I renewed my determination.

notes:
{新|あら}た is a na-adjective meaning new or fresh.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {新|あら}た⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (newly, afresh)
- Noun modifier: {新|あら}たな + noun

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {新|あら}たな⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧ (fresh start)
- {新|あら}た⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{始|はじ}める→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧ (start anew)
- ⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{新|あら}た⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (refresh one's attitude)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧: new (i-adjective, common)
- {新|あら}た: new (na-adjective, more literary/formal)
- ⟦フレッシュ→フレッシュ：23079_furesshu⟧: fresh (loanword)
